criteria: 本地已安装的 DSH 插件包名来自磁盘上真实的 package.json(name/version),不是推测;至少确认一个准确包名
GitHub 官方仓库的 owner/repo 明确,且 star 数与最近一次提交时间都能从 GitHub API 直接读到(两个来源互相印证)
npm 上其它 DeepSeek Harness 相关插件包列出名字+版本+说明,并与本地包名锚定区分「本地已装」与「生态中其它」
GitHub 上的教程/指南类文章或仓库有可点击的链接和标题,数量或来源说得清
全过程只读:没有任何写文件/装包/改配置的操作
最终简报在回复里覆盖上述四条,并标注数据来源与时间点

nodes.description: Read locally installed DSH packages to get exact package names

arguments.command: echo "== HOME=$HOME"; echo "== desktop profile =="; ls -la "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop" 2>&1 | head -30; echo "== desktop plugins =="; ls -la "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins" 2>&1 | head -40; echo "== home plugins =="; ls -la "$HOME/.dsh/plugins" 2>&1 | head -40
arguments.description: List DSH home profiles and plugin directories

arguments.command: echo "== sandbox plugins =="; ls -la "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/plugins" 2>&1 | head -40; echo "== sandbox profiles =="; ls -la "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/profiles" 2>&1 | head -20; for d in "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/profiles"/*; do echo "-- $d"; ls "$d" 2>&1 | head -20; done
arguments.description: List sandbox DSH home plugins and profiles

arguments.command: for d in "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins" "$HOME/.dsh/plugins" "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/plugins"; do echo "=== $d"; ls "$d" 2>&1 | head -30; for f in "$d"/*/package.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "-- $f"; grep -E '"(name|version|description)"' "$f" | head -4; }; done; done
arguments.description: Extract installed plugin package names and versions

arguments.command: echo "== asar checkout =="; ls -la "C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Local/Programs/DeepSeek Harness/resources/app.asar/dsh" 2>&1 | head -40; echo "== workspace deepseek-harness =="; ls -la "D:/code/vibe/deepseek-harness" 2>&1 | head -40; echo "== toolchain =="; npm --version 2>&1; node --version 2>&1; git --version 2>&1
arguments.description: Inspect asar checkout workspace dir toolchain

nodes.description: Find official GitHub repo, stars, last commit

arguments.command: echo "== deepseek-ai org repos =="; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/orgs/deepseek-ai/repos?per_page=100&sort=updated" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -E '"(full_name|stargazers_count|pushed_at|description)"' | head -140
arguments.description: List deepseek-ai org repos with star counts

arguments.command:
REPOS="$(curl -s -m 40 'https://api.github.com/orgs/deepseek-ai/repos?per_page=100'; curl -s -m 40 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=deepseek+harness&sort=stars&per_page=20')"; for slug in $(echo "$REPOS" | tr ',' '
' | grep -oE '"full_name": *"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u); do case "$slug" in *arness*|*Harness*|*dsh*|*DSH*) echo "=== $slug"; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/repos/$slug" | tr ',' '
' | grep -E '"(stargazers_count|forks_count|pushed_at|updated_at|default_branch|html_url|description)"' | head -14; echo "-- last commit"; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/repos/$slug/commits?per_page=1" | tr ',' '
' | grep -E '"(date|message|html_url)"' | head -8;; esac; done
arguments.description: Fetch stars and latest commit for candidate repos

arguments.command: for f in "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins"/*/package.json "$HOME/.dsh/plugins"/*/package.json "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/plugins"/*/package.json "D:/code/vibe/deepseek-harness/package.json"; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; echo "-- $f"; grep -E '"(name|repository|homepage|bugs|publishConfig|author)"' "$f" | head -8; done
arguments.description: Extract repository URLs from local package manifests

nodes.description: Find other DeepSeek Harness packages on npm

arguments.command: for f in "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins"/*/package.json "$HOME/.dsh/plugins"/*/package.json "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/plugins"/*/package.json; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; n=$(grep -m1 '"name"' "$f" | sed -E 's/.*"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]+)".*/\1/'); echo "=== $n"; npm view "$n" version dist-tags description homepage repository --json 2>&1 | head -25; done
arguments.description: Query npm registry for locally installed packages

arguments.command: for q in "deepseek-harness" "deepseek+harness" "dsh+harness" "%22deepseek+harness%22"; do echo "=== $q"; curl -s -m 40 "https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=$q&size=25" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -E '"(name|version|description)"' | head -70; done
arguments.description: Search npm registry API for harness packages

arguments.command: f=$(ls "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins"/*/package.json "$HOME/.dsh/plugins"/*/package.json "D:/code/vibe/dsh-sandbox/home/plugins"/*/package.json 2>/dev/null | head -1); sc=$(grep -m1 '"name"' "$f" | sed -E 's/.*"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"(@[^"/]+)\/.*/\1/'); echo "scope=$sc"; [ -n "$sc" ] && curl -s -m 40 "https://registry.npmjs.org/-/v1/search?text=scope:$sc&size=50" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -E '"(name|version|description)"' | head -120; echo "== npm search cli"; npm search "deepseek harness" --json 2>&1 | head -c 2500
arguments.description: Search npm by scope and CLI keyword search

nodes.description: Find GitHub tutorial articles about DSH

queries: dsh 插件开发 打包 patch 教程 DeepSeek Harness

arguments.command: for q in "deepseek+harness+tutorial" "deepseek+harness+plugin" "%22DeepSeek+Harness%22" "deepseek+harness+%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B"; do echo "=== $q"; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=$q&sort=stars&per_page=15" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -E '"(full_name|description|stargazers_count|pushed_at)"' | head -60; done
arguments.description: Search GitHub repositories for harness tutorials

arguments.command: REPOS="$(curl -s -m 40 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=%22DeepSeek+Harness%22&per_page=15')"; for slug in $(echo "$REPOS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -oE '"full_name": *"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u | head -12); do echo "=== $slug"; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/repos/$slug/readme" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" | grep -inE "tutorial|教程|guide|how to|quickstart|入门|上手" | head -8; done
arguments.description: Scan candidate repo READMEs for tutorial sections

arguments.query: tutorial or guide articles about DeepSeek Harness

nodes.description: Independently re-verify stars, commit date, read-only

arguments.command: REPOS="$(curl -s -m 40 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=deepseek+harness&sort=stars&per_page=10')"; for slug in $(echo "$REPOS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -oE '"full_name": *"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | sort -u | head -5); do echo "=== $slug"; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/repos/$slug" | grep -oE '"stargazers_count":[0-9]+' | head -2; curl -s -m 40 "https://api.github.com/repos/$slug/commits?per_page=3" | grep -oE '"date":"[^"]+"' | head -3; done; echo "== rate limit"; curl -s -m 20 https://api.github.com/rate_limit | head -c 300
arguments.description: Re-verify star counts and commit dates

arguments.command: SLUG=$(curl -s -m 40 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=deepseek+harness&sort=stars&per_page=10' | tr ',' '\n' | grep -oE '"full_name": *"[^"]+"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | head -1); echo "slug=$SLUG"; curl -s -m 40 "https://github.com/$SLUG" | grep -oiE '[0-9,]+ (users )?starred|aria-label="[0-9,]+ users' | head -5; echo "== read-only check =="; git -C D:/code/vibe status --porcelain 2>&1 | head -20; echo "(empty above means clean)"
arguments.description: Cross-check stars on HTML page and repo cleanliness
